notes_for_editor: Very thin: one acquisition line from the Forest Lookouts page plus a map-database name. The record's kind 'tower' rests on the TopoQuest 'Tower' label and the page title only. TopoQuest gives an elevation of 1,299 ft MSL (not stored: facts has no elevation key). No build date, design, staffing or status found. The 102-tower figure is general context from the MDC feature, not about this site. Worth rechecking the MDC and Forest Lookouts pages later for a build or removal record.
